systems.platform: Centralised web platform, as the decree describes it; software not named
systems.owner: Ministère des affaires sociales et de l'action humanitaire (unité technique de gestion attached to the minister's cabinet)
systems.tiers: National, centralised; households registered by the social service

note: Gazette of 4 July 2019. The Congo Digital 2025 strategy (Décret 2019-150) names no civil registration system and says nothing on the état civil. Décret 2019-134 creates the registre social unique, a social-protection registry of poor households (out of scope, classed with the other registers), which may hold data from the registre d'état civil or the registre national d'identification civile 'si nécessaire'; the latter is named without description. Three name-change arrêtés of 19 June 2019 order transcription in the margin of the civil-status registers of Ouenzé and Pointe-Noire, which states nothing on how those registers are kept.
